name: week
title: The speak-up week
subtitle: What is late, what is waiting and who is carrying it. Confidential: case officers only.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select priority,ref,category,detail from v_attention order by priority,category,ref

sections.title: Open cases
sections.sql: select ref,entity,category,severity,status,officer,days_open,ack_due,acknowledged_on,last_update_on,next_step,next_step_due from v_reports where status<>'closed' order by case severity when 'high' then 1 when 'medium' then 2 else 3 end,received_on

sections.title: Case officer workload
sections.sql: select name,open_cases,high_severity,overdue_actions,avg_days_to_close from v_workload order by open_cases desc

name: deadlines
title: Deadlines that protect the discloser
subtitle: Acknowledgements, updates, actions and retaliation checks, in date order.

sections.title: Acknowledgements due
sections.note: New Zealand: 20 working days from receipt, counting the holidays table. Australia: office policy.
sections.sql: select ref,entity,jurisdiction,received_on,ack_due,ack_due-current_date days_left from v_reports where status<>'closed' and acknowledged_on is null and not no_contact_route order by ack_due

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select ref,report,owner,description,due_on,days_left from v_actions where done_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Retaliation checks
sections.sql: select ref,report,officer,due_on,days_left from v_retaliation where done_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Public interest watch
sections.note: Australia: a discloser who told ASIC or APRA may be able to make a public interest disclosure once 90 days have passed. Shown from 75 days.
sections.sql: select ref,entity,regulator_told_on,regulator_told_on+90 ninety_day_point from v_reports where jurisdiction='AU' and status<>'closed' and regulator_told_on is not null order by regulator_told_on

name: programme
title: How the programme is working
subtitle: Volumes, categories and outcomes. No case detail.

sections.title: By entity, last 12 months
sections.sql: select name,jurisdiction,kind,reports_12m,anonymous_12m,open_cases,substantiated_12m,policy_review_due from v_entities order by reports_12m desc

sections.title: By quarter and category
sections.sql: select quarter,category,reports,anonymous,substantiated,avg_days_to_close from v_trends order by quarter,reports desc

sections.title: Identity disclosures
sections.note: Every time someone was told who a discloser is, and on what basis.
sections.sql: select ref,report,on_date,told,told_by,basis from v_identity order by on_date desc
